title: fix: remove internal MCP quality copy
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the internal code-quality note from the dashboard MCP list.
- Keeps the user-facing connection and documentation guidance.

gist.headline: Less hive housekeeping
gist.blurb: The MCP dashboard list lost a note meant for the workshop, not the visitors. Connection steps and docs remain right where they belong.
gist.summary: Removed an internal code-quality note from the dashboard MCP server list while preserving the user-facing connection and documentation guidance.
gist.impact: Developers browsing MCP servers now get a cleaner list focused on connecting their tools and finding the relevant docs.
gist.visual_concept: A tidy MCP connection board in a cozy garden hackerspace: Polli gently removes a small maintenance sticky note from a CRT terminal while the useful plug icon and documentation booklet remain clearly displayed. The scene represents internal workshop clutter being cleared away without disturbing the tools developers need.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden hackerspace where the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny librarian glasses and carefully removes a small sticky note from an MCP connection board beside a glowing retro CRT terminal, while a plug icon and open documentation booklet stay in place among code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle scanlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
